## Teaching approach

I aim to help students connect concepts and evidence to real policy and political problems. Across substantive and methods courses, I emphasise **critical reading, transparent reasoning, research design, evidence evaluation and clear communication**. My experience teaching in different institutional and national settings has also made me attentive to varied disciplinary backgrounds and learning needs.

## Academic and editorial service

Alongside teaching, I have contributed to academic publishing, programme development and institutional service. Current and recent roles include **Reviewing Editor, Springer Nature (2026–present)**, **Member of the Editorial Advisory Board, Himalayan Politics (2024–present)** and **Founding Member, Academic Forum, UK Ammonia Alliance (2026–present)**.

Earlier service at GC University Lahore included coordinating the PhD and MPhil Research Colloquium, developing and coordinating evening academic programmes, supporting international research collaboration, supervising administrative staff, and helping organise major conferences.
